name: Bangladesh Cubing Fiesta 2025
information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjQzMDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--2ab56a8c6da5dbf1d490edcc0dbd22218b0c579d/Cube%20Fiesta%20Logo%20PNG-01%20r.png)

1. The competition will take place at the [BU Permanent Campus](https://goo.gl/maps/BwsAkDbcdVLMLCLW9), not on any other campuses spread across Mohammadpur. 
2. You'll have to be present at the competition area at least 10 minutes before the start of your event.
3. All the necessary information is given the Tabs, please have a look.
4. Join [CubistBD](https://www.facebook.com/groups/cubingbangladesh/) to get updates.
